newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS to review Southam, Hollinger.
newsitem.headline: DBRS to review Southam, Hollinger.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Wednesday that it placed Southam Inc under review, with negative implications and Hollinger Inc under review with developing implications.

The Toronto-based ratings agency said in a statement that it placed the two companies under review pending additional details of Hollinger's proposal to acquire the remaining shares of Southam that it does not already own.
DBRS currently rates Southam notes at BBB (high) with a stable trend and commercial paper at R-1 (low) with a negative trend.
Dominion rated Hollinger's Southam-linked convertible debentures at BB, liquid yield option notes at BB (low), First DT Holdings Ltd preferred shares at Pfd-4. All the ratings carry stable trends.
